g.text: Lateness is the preparation finish time minus its deadline.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Fresh success requires both an on-time finish and an allowed result

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: that matches the input versions required for this output.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: ell: lateness, negative means early; prep: local preparation; Z: success flag.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: a_j: result for job j; kappa_j: required input/version cutoff. Indicators multiply as AND.

g.text: Other session, format and integrity checks also apply.

g.text: Continuity and fresh success need separate reporting. An older bar may avoid a gap while failing this test.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: A later edit does not retroactively invalidate a frozen bar. Prepared success still needs playback verification.
